user.title: Add an AI pool
user.description: A pool publishes one entity that routes calls across several providers.

members.title: Members and policy
members.description: Members are tried in the order the strategy decides. A failing member is skipped and the next one is tried.

limits.title: Allowances
limits.description: Declared allowances per member for {members}: requests per day, then requests per minute. Use 0 where the limit is unknown. Providers do not report remaining quota, so these numbers only steer the rotation — a real refusal is always detected from the error. Google publishes no fixed figures: read yours at https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit, and note they are per project rather than per API key.
